operation.summary: List the linked sources of a namespace: instrument, provider, custody, cap and whether the key is set. A key is never returned

query.name: namespace
query.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build; live is refused with platform_unsupported

operation.returns: sources[{id, instrument, provider, class, namespace, funder, custody, cap provider|core_only, configured, device, host, on, time_source, usage_read, available, linked_at}], instruments[]
